0022600180.text: The Thunder host the Cleveland Cavaliers in their eighth game of the 2026-27 season, sitting at 5-2 on a one-game winning streak and 0.5 games back for 2nd in the Northwest, with a 3-0 home record. Cleveland is 4-3 on a one-game losing streak, 2 games back for 2nd in the Central, and 1-2 on the road. Oklahoma City is without Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), while Cleveland is missing Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Peyton Watson (hamstring soreness). Oklahoma City leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 and won the 2025-26 series 2-0, including a 117-112 win in Cleveland on November 2.
